reward.reward: Per-controlled-decision oracle correctness, 0/1; all tied optimal actions accepted.
reward.baseline: Mean trajectory-average step reward of the OTHER replicas in this reset group; no std normalization.
reward.weighting: Each trajectory equal weight; average over its actually generated decisions and response tokens.
reward.failure: Failed call binary reward=0 and separate protocol advantage=-0.2; stop episode; preserve earlier local rewards; no retry.
reward.batching: Fixed question groups per optimizer update; token budget only stops training after a complete update.
reward.reset: One entrance, hidden world and focal player per group; independent model/reference RNG streams per replica.
reward.continuation: Same frozen initial terminal oracle for partners and focal after k; early native terminal ends episode.
reward.objective: On-policy local decision correctness, not an equivalent estimator of terminal-utility policy gradient.
reward.infrastructure: Transport, context, missing behavior evidence and oracle failures abort collection without committing cursor.
